title: 跨构建工具链落在 tooldir 目录
claim_text: 交叉构建先在主机侧生成整套工具链，产物落于 tooldir 目录，主机原生工具不被污染。
quote: The command to create the toolchain is quite simple, using NetBSD's src/build.sh script.
publisher_title: NetBSD Guide 第 33 章 Crosscompiling NetBSD with build.sh
notes: 第二来源为 BSDCon 2003 作者论文，述 $TOOLDIR 与主机工具隔离之设计。

title: DESTDIR 承接安装树
claim_text: 构建产物按 DESTDIR 指定的安装根目录落盘，该路径在 build.sh 结果汇总中显式列出。
quote: DESTDIR path: /home/nia/obj/destdir.evbarm
publisher_title: NetBSD Guide 第 33 章 33.1 Building the toolchain
notes: 第二来源引 BUILDING 源树布局条，明 DESTDIR/etc 为发行快照安装面；该文件取自 NetBSD 官方 GitHub 镜像（源码树正本，cvsweb 反爬不可取）。

title: 构建主机、宿主与目标三者分列
claim_text: NetBSD 交叉构建明确区分 target、host 与 build host 三种角色。
quote: One part of cross compilers that is often confusing is the difference between a “target”, a “host” and a “build host”.
publisher_title: build.sh: Cross-building NetBSD（BSDCon 2003）
notes: 第二来源引 BUILDING 开篇，述原生与交叉构建程序同构、跨架构或跨 OS 皆可。

title: build.sh -P 固定源码时间戳
claim_text: build.sh 以 -P 选项把 MKREPRO 与 MKREPRO_TIMESTAMP 设为源码时间戳，供可重复构建使用。
quote: -P Set MKREPRO and MKREPRO_TIMESTAMP to the latest source CVS timestamp for reproducible builds.
publisher_title: NetBSD Guide 第 33 章 33.7.3 Using build.sh options
notes: 第二来源为 BUILDING 的 mk 变量表，仅证 MKREPRO 与 MKREPRO_TIMESTAMP 在场，不证语义；语义以 Guide 单源为主。

title: 顶层模块分立 src 与 xsrc
claim_text: 源码树按顶层模块分治，src 与 xsrc 各自独立，pkgsrc 与 htdocs 另列。
quote: src The main NetBSD system sources, that is, the contents of the system source tree excluding those pieces in other top-level directories in the CVS repository (listed here).
publisher_title: Top-level modules in the CVS repository
notes: 第二来源引 BUILDING 源树布局条，述 bin 至 usr.sbin 为用户态目录、sys 为内核目录。

title: sys/arch 按端口分列机器架构
claim_text: 内核描述文件按端口分散存放，由 machine 语句自动引入，主文件为 conf/files。
quote: The machine statement, usually found in the std.${MACHINE} file, hides this from the user by automatically including all the descriptive files spread all around the kernel source tree, the main one being conf/files.
publisher_title: config(5) kernel configuration file syntax
notes: 第二来源引 Guide 33.2 的端口 conf 目录路径示例，证配置文件落在 sys/arch 之下。

title: riscv 端口登记三年后方入发行
claim_text: riscv 端口于 2023 年登记进 sys/arch 端口表，至 11.0 才首次进入稳定发行。
quote: RISC-V based machines.
publisher_title: sys/arch/README（$NetBSD: README,v 1.68 2026/09/25）
notes: 源文件该行为四栏制表符分隔：riscv／riscv64／20230507／RISC-V based machines.；本行只逐字引第四栏，日期栏见注。

title: 源码树由 CVS 统一纳管
claim_text: 源码树仍以 CVS 主库维护，获取源码的推荐途径为下载 tarball 后以 cvs(1) 更新。
quote: This chapter explains a number of different ways to obtain the NetBSD sources, although the preferred method is to download the tarballs and then update via cvs(1).
publisher_title: NetBSD Guide 第 32 章 Obtaining the sources
notes: 另存 GitHub 镜像与 mercurial／fossil 镜像；本行只证 CVS 主库在册，不称其为唯一渠道。

title: 端口表逐年增列与除名
claim_text: 端口表逐行登记机器架构与起始日期，virt68k 与 hb68k 为近年新增条目。
quote: Homebrew machines based on the Motorola 68K CPUs
publisher_title: sys/arch/README（$NetBSD: README,v 1.68 2026/09/25）
notes: 同表记 virt68k／m68k／20240101、hb68k／m68000,m68k／20260718；本行只逐字引描述栏。

title: 内核配置从 std 文件起手
claim_text: 内核以配置文件为入口，经 config(1) 生成头文件与 Makefile，配置文件落在端口 conf 目录。
quote: The kernel configuration file specifies the way the kernel should be compiled by the rest of the toolchain.
publisher_title: config(5) kernel configuration file syntax
notes: 第二来源引 Guide 33.2 的命令行，路径为 sys/arch/evbarm/conf，先 cp GENERIC64 再跑 nbconfig。

title: 用户空间待工具链就绪再编
claim_text: 用户空间在工具链就绪后编译，build.sh 每次调用会尝试重建工具，故常以 update 省时。
quote: Since build.sh will attempt to rebuild the tools at every invocation, using “update” saves time.
publisher_title: NetBSD Guide 第 33 章 33.5 Building the userland
notes: 第二来源述 $TOOLDIR 工具用于向 $DESTDIR 安装系统，次序为工具先于目标。

title: 工具、内核与用户态三段递进
claim_text: 构建按工具链、内核、用户态三段递进，前段产物为后段前提。
quote: By now it is probably becoming clear that the toolchain actually works in stages. First the toolchain is built, then a kernel.
publisher_title: NetBSD Guide 第 33 章 33.5 Building the userland
notes: 第二来源引 BUILDING 对 build.sh 的定义：先建主机工具，再从零建 NetBSD 系统。

title: 增量重跑省去全树重编
claim_text: 工具已建者可用 -u 只重建变动部分，不必整树重编。
quote: If the tools have been built previously and they only need to be updated, then the update option "-u" can be used to only rebuild tools that have changed
publisher_title: NetBSD Guide 第 33 章 33.1 Building the toolchain
notes: 仅一源；构建中断的排查路径无官方成文表述，题面已收窄至 -u 可证部分，待主会话裁定是否补证或降题。

title: 顶层 Makefile 退居次位
claim_text: 顶层 Makefile 已被 build.sh 取代为推荐构建入口，旧法仅留作专家用法。
quote: Intended for expert use with knowledge of its shortcomings, it has been superseded by the build.sh shell script as the recommended means for building NetBSD.
publisher_title: BUILDING(8) Procedure for building NetBSD from source code
notes: 第二来源引 Guide 33 开篇：建整个 NetBSD 一般以 build.sh 为首选。

title: 发布工程统筹排期与 pull-up
claim_text: 发布工程组负责发行排期、政策与 pull-up 处理，并对分支改动做质量把关。
quote: The Release Engineering group. They organize release schedules, policies, and pullups.
publisher_title: NetBSD People: Other Groups within the NetBSD Project
notes: 第二来源述 pull-up 请求送交 releng，以便分支改动受监控、质量得维持。

title: 分支冻结后只收 pull-up
claim_text: 分支建立后改动只经 pull-up 请求进入，且不得改内核 ABI 或共享库接口。
quote: Pullups may not change the kernel ABI. In other words: everything that would cause a kernel version bump in -current can not be pulled up.
publisher_title: NetBSD Release Engineering: Pull-up Requests
notes: 第二来源为 releng 状态页分支栏：netbsd-11 已分支、11.0 的 pullups 正在受理。

title: pull-up 须附提交邮件或补丁
claim_text: pull-up 请求须先在分支上测试，并附提交邮件全文或可套用补丁，逐张票据跟踪。
quote: Pull-up requests should be tested in the release branch before being submitted to the release engineering team.
publisher_title: NetBSD Release Engineering: Pull-up Requests
notes: 第二来源为 NetBSD 11 pullup 票据跟踪页；票据状态分 open／stalled／resolved 三档。

title: releng 小组十一人分掌发行
claim_text: releng 组现由十一人组成，按分支轮值处理发行与 pull-up 事务。
quote: Members: Stephen Borrill, Manuel Bouyer, David Brownlee, Julian Coleman, Alistair G. Crooks, Havard Eidnes, Martin Husemann, Soren Jacobsen, Phil Nelson, Jeff Rizzo, and SAITOH Masanobu.
publisher_title: NetBSD People: Other Groups within the NetBSD Project
notes: 人数为 2026-11-26 现况，非历年定数；入册宜标时点，勿作历史常量。

title: 1.6 周期内三十九平台近逐日
claim_text: 1.6 发行周期内发布工程借 build.sh 对 39 个平台近逐日交叉构建二进制发行件。
quote: NetBSD 1.6 was the first release to be shipped with build.sh, and the Release Engineering group of the NetBSD Project took advantage of it to cross-build binary releases for 39 platforms on a near daily basis during the release cycle for NetBSD 1.6
publisher_title: build.sh: Cross-building NetBSD（BSDCon 2003）
notes: 第二来源为 releng 状态页的 Daily binary snapshots 入口，只证逐日构建做法延续，年代与平台数以论文为准。

title: images 与 shared 分流
claim_text: 发行树把共享件按 machine_arch 收进 shared 子目录，其余镜像按机器并列。
quote: Files which may be shared by all systems of the same <machine_arch> will be located in .../NetBSD-<rel>/shared/<machine_arch>/ with symbolic links pointing to these files from the <machine> subdirectory.
publisher_title: release(7) layout of NetBSD releases and snapshots
notes: 第二来源为 11.0 公告下载清单，按 amd64／i386／sparc64／macppc 等机器分列 USB、DVD、CD 镜像。

title: 安装镜像由 build.sh 生成
claim_text: 可引导安装镜像与 ISO 由 build.sh 的 install-image、iso-image 目标生成。
quote: These images are created with ``./build.sh ... install-image'' in src.
publisher_title: release(7) layout of NetBSD releases and snapshots
notes: 第二来源为 11.0 公告，其下载位即 install.img.gz 与 dvd.iso 两类构建产物。

title: 快照 README 注明是否官方
claim_text: 快照顶层 README 注明构建者与构建情形，据此区分官方快照与非官方快照。
quote: There may also be a README file at the top-level, describing who built the snapshot and under what circumstances (e.g., whether it's an official NetBSD snapshot, or not).
publisher_title: release(7) layout of NetBSD releases and snapshots
notes: 第二来源为 releng 状态页，正式发行与分支受理状态并列公布，与快照面分列。

title: 发行散列经安全官密钥签署
claim_text: 发行件随附全部文件的散列清单，并由 NetBSD 安全官的 PGP 密钥签署。
quote: signed with the NetBSD Security Officer's PGP key, of all files in the distribution.
publisher_title: Announcing NetBSD 11.0 (July 30, 2026)
notes: 第二来源为 release(7) 的 MD5／SHA512 清单条，述摘要格式与用途。

title: ATF 自 5.0 起随系统发行
claim_text: 测试套件以 ATF 框架接入源码树，tests 目录为新框架，regress 为未迁完的旧测试。
quote: tests/ uses the atf(7) test framework; regress/ contains older tests that have not yet been migrated to atf(7).
publisher_title: BUILDING(8) Procedure for building NetBSD from source code
notes: 第二来源记 ATF 自 NetBSD 5.0 起随系统发行；该年份仅单源，题面以“随系统发行”为限。

title: 测试套件单列为 tests.tgz
claim_text: 测试套件作为独立安装集 tests.tgz 发行，测试程序装在 /usr/tests 之下。
quote: The NetBSD test suite is distributed as a separate installation set, named tests.tgz, and the test programs are all installed under the /usr/tests hierarchy.
publisher_title: tests(7) introduction to the NetBSD test suite
notes: 第二来源为 release(7) 的 tests.tgz 条，述该集收 tests(7) 与 atf(7) 测试。

title: 测试报告可转 csv 与 xml
claim_text: 测试输出由 atf-report 转为多种格式，含机器可读的 csv 与单文件 xml。
quote: atf-report reads the output of atf-run and transforms it to different formats.
publisher_title: atf-report(1) transforms the output of atf-run to different formats
notes: 第二来源为 tests(7) 的 atf-run 管道示例；csv 行式 tc／tp 记法与 xml 便于 xsltproc 转 HTML 见 atf-report(1) 格式表。

title: 官方测试按分支逐日重跑
claim_text: 官方测试在 babylon4 与 babylon5 上运行，覆盖 HEAD 与 netbsd-11／10／9 各分支，频次约每日一次。
quote: These are run on babylon4.NetBSD.org and babylon5.NetBSD.org.
publisher_title: Official test runs（releng 测试结果页）
notes: 仅一源；表中各分支频次为 ca 1x daily，平台为 NVMM／QEMU／Anita；未见“测试结果即发布门槛”的官方表述，题面已避“闸门”义。

title: 测试扩面之后的人力承接
claim_text: 测试覆盖面扩张后的维护人力与成本，未见于 NetBSD 官方公开文献。
notes: 已检索 NetBSD Guide 全书、BUILDING、tests(7)／atf-report(1)、releng 测试页、11.0 公告，均无维护成本或人力配置表述；题面暂以中性名词短语占位，不得据以填块。
